summary: Skier killed in avalanche outside Snowmass Ski Area
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff, Snowmass ski patrol, Mountain Rescue Aspen
notes: Sands Chute off Sneaky's Run, East Snowmass Creek Valley; second of three skiers caught, companions found him in ~5 min but CPR failed. Recovery delayed by instability and a second slide that moved the body ~200 ft; body recovered the following Tuesday by Mountain Rescue Aspen + Snowmass Ski Patrol with avalanche dogs and a DBS Helicopters helicopter. Coroner: asphyxiation. CSAR sidecountry-is-backcountry retrospective (opened run 285).
